From: Alicia Khan <alicia.khan@brightlayer.io>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Connector success revenue handoff & commission questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team at BrightLayer is excited about the connector and we want to align on commercials so we can move to pilot. A few specific items we need clarity on before we lock dates: 

- Revenue split for first-year implementation + subscription revenue (how do you calculate gross-to-net for bundled services?)
- Referral vs. reseller crediting: if our sales rep brings the opportunity but Redwood handles billing, how is the commission paid and when?
- Lead registration window and proof-of-intro (what counts as accepted evidence?)
- Clawback / churn protection (we have standard 12-month retention requirements)

I've attached our RFP extract so you can see the revenue cadence we're expecting. If you can send a short bulleted confirmation we can present internally and sign a provisional LOI.

Attachments: BrightLayer_RFP.pdf (pdf, 1 page summary)

Looking forward — can we target a short call this week if helpful.

Best,
Alicia Khan
VP, Partnerships | BrightLayer Integrations
Alicia.khan@brightlayer.io | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Khan <alicia.khan@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Connector success revenue handoff & commission questions

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the RFP excerpt. Below is a pragmatic, pilot-first proposal that aims to keep billing simple for BrightLayer while protecting partner economics.

(Internal note: @ben @marissa please confirm the math and claim windows below; I've included likely escalation points.)

Proposal (summary):
- First-year commercial split (implementation fee + recurring): 70/30 (BrightLayer/Redwood) on net ARR attributable to the connector during the first 12 months following go-live. Implementation professional services are split 60/40 if Redwood delivers >50% of the integration hours.
- Renewal/upsell referrals: 10% of net ARR for years 2+ for opportunities where BrightLayer is the source of record and we continue to bill directly.
- Lead registration window: 90 days from partner introduction to customer signature. Proof-of-intro: (a) HubSpot/CRM export with timestamped activity and intro email thread or (b) DocuSign envelope showing BrightLayer contact on record.
- Clawback: pro-rated 12-month clawback if customer cancels within 12 months; clawbacks apply to commissions paid on net ARR; implementation fees excluded once activity hours are invoiced.
- Payment cadence: Redwood pays quarterly within 45 days of quarter close, with an itemized payout statement.

Attachments: provisional-deal-sheet.pdf (contains worked examples + sample payout schedule)

Next steps:
1) If that structure looks okay, we'll share a one-page Partner Registration form + MSA redline you can sign to lock the pilot.
2) Ben and Marissa will confirm any special billing routing and whether we need a reseller contract vs. referral contract for your target accounts.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call. When's good for you?

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Partners | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Olga — that outline is sensible and aligns with our current partner economics guardrails. A few clarifications from GTM/comp: 

- Calculation: "net ARR attributable to the connector" = ARR from subscription line items where connector is listed as the primary integration on the invoice. We'll need the first 6 months of billing extracts to validate attribution.
- Implementation split: we agree 60/40 if Redwood provides >50% of the delivery hours. If BrightLayer delivers professional services, you'll bill them directly and Redwood pays commission per our referral schedule.
- Lead registration evidence: HubSpot export + intro email preferred. DocuSign as secondary proof only when HubSpot residency is missing.
- Payment cadence: 45 days QTR + itemized statement works. We will add a simple audit clause allowing limited reconciliation access for 12 months post-payout.

Marissa — can you confirm the registration form template and the claim escalation flow (30/60/90 days) especially around multi-touch attribution? Mateo — please flag any billing route constraints if the customer insists on BrightLayer billing.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

Subject: Finalized registration flow, docs, and next steps for pilot (BrightLayer)

Hi Alicia / team — sorry for the slight delay. Per Olga and Ben's notes, we've formalized the operational flow and included the docs you'll need to register the pilot and preserve partner credit. Summary below plus links/attachments.

Operational playbook (short):
1) Partner Registration: BrightLayer completes the attached partner-registration-form.xlsx and attaches the intro email thread. Submission locks a 90-day claim window.
2) Proof-of-intro: preferred = HubSpot activity export (csv, timestamped) OR a DocuSign envelope with BrightLayer contact. If neither, we accept a signed intro affidavit signed by your AE + Redwood SE.
3) Attribution & validation: Redwood partner ops validates attribution within 10 business days of form submission. If we need more info, we'll escalate to 1:1 and put the opportunity in "Pending Validation" for no more than 20 business days.
4) Payouts & clawback: commissions paid quarterly (45 days post-quarter). 12-month pro-rata clawback applies to any cancellation that reduces ARR attributable to the connector; implementation fees only clawed back if not invoiced.

Attachments & links:
- partner-registration-form.xlsx (fillable)
- provisional-deal-sheet.pdf (worked examples)
- signed-msa-draft.pdf (copy of the MSA with partner addendum — please countersign)
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456/BL-089
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/BL-089-MSA

Next steps for BrightLayer:
- Complete the registration form and attach your HubSpot activity export by EOD next Tue (2026-12-14).
- Countersign the MSA DocuSign envelope if OK with the commercial terms; reach out for redlines.

If you prefer a 30-min sync to walk through the short form, happy to book one. Thanks — excited to get this pilot live.

—Marissa Cole
Partner Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
